input:
Earlier scenes:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

This scene:
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
(none on this scene)

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 从五岁一直学哲学：从五岁开始一直学哲学，Use the structure “从 + time + 开始” to state when an ongoing action begins. [teacher rule: cong_kaishi]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子从五岁开始一直学哲学：他从五岁开始一直学哲学，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the previous sentence has already named the same character and no competing referent intervenes. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 成为很有名的哲学家：成为了很有名的哲学家，This is a completed change of state in the narrative, so the verb takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: The teacher’s required pattern for a starting time is 从五岁开始, so 从五岁一直学哲学 is missing 开始.
孟子 was just mentioned in the preceding sentence, so the teacher’s reference rule requires the close re-reference 他.
Becoming a famous philosopher is presented as a completed later change of state, so 成为了 is appropriate.
